title: DR1 counts the list as "Show 1-4 of 4 results" whatever the number; the frontend switches between "No Results", "Showing 1 Result" and "Showing 1 to 8 of 20 Results", with Results capitalised.

finding.frontend: The count above the list is built from four different sentences depending on how many rows came back: "No Results", "Showing 1 Result", "Showing 1 of 4 Results" and "Showing 1 to 8 of 20 Results" (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/copy/copy.en.js:37-47). Results and Result are capitalised mid-sentence, and the wording changes shape as the list grows, so the same place on the page reads differently from one visit to the next.
finding.prototype: DR1 uses one sentence in one shape — "Show {start}-{end} of {total} results", printed above the sort control (app/views/dashboard.html:236, built at app/routes.js:6700-6714). With nothing in the list it reads "Show 0 of 0 results". Results is lower case throughout.
finding.difference: Replace the four frontend sentences with DR1's single form: a range, a total, and the word results in lower case. Keep one empty-list wording. This also removes the special case where searching for a reference and finding nothing swaps in a different message, since the count sentence then covers it.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a capitalised "Results", or a second wording for the count, in DR1's root dashboard view.
finding.correction: Sound and exactly cited. The captured DR1 dashboard prints Show 1-4 of 4 results, which is what the picture shows too, and buildDashboardResultsText at app/routes.js:6700-6714 has only the one shape plus the empty-list line the finding quotes. The four frontend sentences are all present at copy.en.js:40-44, inside the pagination block the finding cites as 37-47. The claim about the special case is right and I checked the mechanism rather than taking it on trust: when a reference number is present the controller swaps the empty-list wording for the search copy (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/controller.js:77-83), which is how a fruitless search comes back as "No notifications found" instead of "No Results". One trap checked and it does not bite: buildDashboardResultsText has a second wording behind a testing session flag, but the capture is not a testing session, so Show 1-4 of 4 results is DR1's real output.
